$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — C3 (CE-2152) the rescue score stays low while the fight is hot. From the header's Judge (1)-(4): at contact the check drops Rifleman 3 to 25 HP; for 30 s no CasualtyCare task, no CarryCasualty task, nobody carries him; then the check sets the three hostiles to 0 HP and the squad goes (CasualtyCare within 20 s), the Medic carries, puts him down alive. 30 s and 20 s are the Judge's own windows. NOT expressed: the 'return to the fight' and the 2.5 m cover point (HTTP maneuver data).
